command:
set -euo pipefail
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 seimensch-vps 'echo ===IDENTITY===; hostname; id -u; echo ===RUNTIME_PATHS===; for p in /workspace/omega_runtime /workspace/omega_runtime/current /workspace/omega_runtime/state /workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then ls -ld "$p"; else echo ABSENT:$p; fi; done; echo ===PROCESSES===; ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,lstart,cmd | grep -E "[o]mega\.(supervisor|supervisor_outer|grid_runtime|spool_bridge|relay_entrypoint|master_bridge|telemetry)" || true; echo ===SYSTEMD===; systemctl list-unit-files --no-pager | grep -E "omega|frankenstein" || true; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-pager | grep -E "omega|frankenstein" || true; echo ===STATUS===; [ -r /workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json ] && cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json || true'
